parts.text: {"scenario_id":"column-rename"}
A municipality renamed name to full_name: repaired with update_field_sources; 6/6 validation checks passed; contract gate passed.
{"scenario_id":"delimiter-change"}
A CSV publisher changed comma delimiters to semicolons: repaired with set_delimiter; 8/8 validation checks passed; contract gate passed.
{"scenario_id":"integer-decimal"}
Integer counts began arriving with a decimal suffix: repaired with set_cast; 6/6 validation checks passed; contract gate passed.
{"scenario_id":"date-format"}
ISO dates changed to day-first dates: repaired with set_date_format; 6/6 validation checks passed; contract gate passed.
{"scenario_id":"boolean-vocabulary"}
Boolean labels changed from yes and no to si and no: repaired with set_boolean_values; 6/6 validation checks passed; contract gate passed.
{"scenario_id":"json-record-path"}
A JSON API nested items under result.records: repaired with set_record_path; 6/6 validation checks passed; contract gate passed.
{"scenario_id":"join-name"}
A full name was split into first and last name columns: repaired with set_join_source; 6/6 validation checks passed; contract gate passed.
{"scenario_id":"split-coordinates"}
Latitude and longitude were combined into coordinates: repaired with set_split_source; 8/8 validation checks passed; contract gate passed.
{"scenario_id":"missing-identifier"}
The publisher removed the required stable identifier: escalated with escalate; 3/6 validation checks passed; contract gate failed because no identifier can be fabricated safely.
{"scenario_id":"duplicate-identifier"}
The source began publishing duplicate identifiers: escalated with escalate; 5/6 validation checks passed; contract gate failed because no evidence identifies the authoritative duplicate row.
